_about: Internal terms that must never reach customer copy (REQ-059). Each term is a regular expression. Node (frontend source) and Python (notebook strings) both read this file, so the list lives in one place. Add a term here when a run surfaces a new internal name.

terms.why: run bookkeeping numbers such as 'batch 1 depth0 attempt1'
prompt registry keys such as FILTER_BUSINESS_TABLES_PROMPT
an internal App page id such as 'page n06_u01' (REQ-237): person copy names an App page by its title
Inspire's bare internal object names such as __constraints (REQ-227: a Genie change line named one). A catalog.schema.table name is not a bare token and is kept (D-NAMES)
an internal use case id such as 'N06-U01' (REQ-258): the Ask Genie panel names the use case by its title; the id stays in Genie-facing text (D-NAMES)
Inspire's internal word for the extra tables a part draws (REQ-227)
the discovery mode name as a label on run output; the chooser may name the modes, run output says Discovery
a Python or pandas object dump such as '<bound method Series.prod of ... Name: 165, dtype: object>' (REQ-249): Genie's code formatted a method or a Series instead of its value
